observations: Photo 0 shows a large, yellowish-brown engine with visible wear, including rust and grime. It has a black plastic cover on top, with a rectangular opening in the center. Various hoses, pipes, and a white filter are attached. The engine appears to be part of a larger machine, possibly a truck or construction vehicle.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the top of the engine. The black plastic cover has a label with 'CAT' and '5.3' visible. There are also two white stickers with text, but the text is not legible. The engine block below is yellow and shows signs of use and oil residue.
The engine is in a workshop or storage area, with tools and parts scattered around. A person in orange workwear is visible in both photos, suggesting it is being handled or stored.
The watermark 'DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos, indicating the seller's platform.

claims.evidence: The engine appears to be a Caterpillar C9 based on the 'CAT' and '5.3' label in photo 1, but the full set of parts is not visible. The seller claims 'complete', but no proof of all components is shown.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may not be in working condition or may have hidden mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft, oil pan) to verify condition.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts (e.g., alternator, ECU, sensors, or accessories).
risks.proof: A full 360-degree view of the engine with all components laid out, or a photo showing the complete set of parts included.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle or engine's VIN plate, or a video showing the engine's history and condition.

proof_requests: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the internal components.
A full 360-degree view of the engine with all components laid out.
A photo of the vehicle or engine's VIN plate to verify origin and condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
